concept.title: Fitness and exercise classes
concept.shortdesc: Classes and sessions for physical activity such as swimming, yoga, Pilates, Tai Chi, martial arts, dance and general fitness.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Using a swimming pool, or joining swimming sessions and lessons for children and adults.
: Pilates classes and sessions, including mat work and reformer Pilates, sometimes combined with yoga.
: Yoga classes, sessions and workshops of various styles, including gentle, flowing and Vinyasa yoga.
: Classes and sessions in Tai Chi, Qigong and related gentle movement practices such as Shibashi and Taiji.
: Taking part in martial arts classes or sessions such as karate, Taekwon-Do, aikido or mixed martial arts, for adults, children or families.
: Taking part in general fitness, keep-fit or exercise classes and sessions, including gentle exercise, boxercise, group workouts and coached sports sessions.
: Taking part in dance classes, sessions and groups, including ballet and dance-based fitness workouts.
